summary: Inspected /app/kv-store.proto: it defines service KVStore with rpc GetVal(GetValRequest)->GetValResponse and rpc SetVal(SetValRequest)->SetValResponse; GetValRequest has string key, GetValResponse has int32 val, SetValRequest has string key and int32 val, and SetValResponse has int32 val. Inspected /app/server.py: it defines a Server class, registers the KVStore servicer, and binds on port 5328 via add_insecure_port('[::]:5328'). The workspace state also includes generated /app/kv_store_pb2.py and /app/kv_store_pb2_grpc.py produced by grpc_tools.protoc; the recorded probe imported them from python3 successfully. The live RPC probe on localhost:5328 used the generated stubs to call SetVal(key='alpha', val=7) and then GetVal(key='alpha'); the returned value was 7, matching the stored int. The install evidence shows grpcio==1.73.0 and grpcio-tools==1.73.0 were installed and imported successfully.
